Game Hub: a profile for each game (brightness, volume, do not disturb, network; put back when the game closes), performance per game (mode, resolution, FPS cap), a transparent Material look, covers from Google Play, a banner view, favourites, a 30-day chart, weekly goals, play-time achievements and a menu over the running game (heat and battery warnings, FPS counter, screen recording). A hidden game is hidden again when it closes.

- Files: zip compresses on all cores, zip with a password (AES-256), a duplicate finder, pause and resume of a copy, lighter previews, faster extraction of picked entries.
- Keyboard: the space slide moves between wrapped lines, long copies are kept in the clipboard, no pin button beside the copied item or photo.
- Book reader: the speed reading shows the page it reached and marks the word it stopped on.
- Weather: empty values around midnight no longer break the saved forecast; the notifications open the weather app.
- Network: the latency test is part of the speed test. Device opens on Overview.
- Island: a notification light around the camera.
